request.ladder_resolution: symbology.resolve(parent=SPXW.OPT, stype_out=instrument_id) for the session, then keep only symbols whose own OSI expiry equals the session date
request.same_day_rule: A requested and saved row must have a valid SPXW OSI symbol whose own YYMMDD expiry equals its session. No trading-calendar membership is used. The rule is applied at request time, not only after saving.

semantic_freeze_rule: Changing this declaration, the acquisition runner, the source inventory, request schemas, OSI filter, session bounds, or destination after a vendor cost preflight cancels the preflight and requires a fresh owner decision.

source_ohlcv_inventory.inclusion: all and only source parquet files in range with Parquet metadata num_rows > 0

supersedes.reason: Runner hardening only; no change to dataset, schemas, request shape, date range, inventory, destination or ceiling. Under V3 the acquisition re-resolved every declared session's ladder before checking whether its outputs already existed, so a restart made ~800 symbology calls to reach new work and a single transient vendor 504 discarded the whole attempt; the vendor was measured degraded on 2026-08-16 (resolves 3-29 s, repeated 504s). V4 skips sessions whose outputs both exist before any vendor call, retries transport failures with backoff while never retrying a refusal, and checkpoints the preflight so a late failure cannot discard the pass. 444 of 794 sessions were already acquired under V3 and are retained; the ceiling still counts every declared session.
